100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On October 22, 1926, the British House of Commons debated the implications of the recent General Strike in Britain, highlighting tensions between labor and government. In the United States, the stock market showed signs of volatility as investors grew increasingly cautious, prompting discussions about economic stability. Meanwhile, in Germany, the ongoing political unrest continued to threaten the Weimar Republic, raising concerns among European leaders about potential fascist movements.
